accessibility_and_ux_states.camera_not_allowed: High-contrast tactical fallback card explaining browser camera permissions with direct Retry and Demo Simulation mode trigger.

accessibility_and_ux_states.no_hand_detected: Amber pulsing 'SEARCHING TARGET // POSITION HAND IN RETICLE' HUD label.
accessibility_and_ux_states.hand_locked: Glowing cyan reticle with 'TARGET ACQUIRED // 21 NODES ACTIVE' and live confidence meter.
accessibility_and_ux_states.gesture_executed: Audible/visual tactile flare, subtle green border flash on slide stage, and command banner showing the dispatched trigger.

implementation_notes_for_agent.engine_strategy: Use `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` or `@tensorflow-models/hand-pose-detection` with `@tensorflow/tfjs-core`. In case of network sandbox / CDN issues in container environments, provide a high-precision algorithmic geometric kinematic classifier fallback that calculates finger extension states and thumb angles directly from the 21 normalized landmarks (pip vs tip Euclidean coordinates) so the app works instantaneously with 100% reliability.
implementation_notes_for_agent.cooldown_debounce: Implement a 700ms cooldown window between gesture triggers to prevent slide runaway.
implementation_notes_for_agent.canvas_dpi: Synchronize video `videoWidth`/`videoHeight` to `<canvas>` element dimensions and scale coordinates accurately.
implementation_notes_for_agent.styling_primitives: Utilize Tailwind CSS v4 alongside Radix / Lucide icons. Monospaced indicators for all coordinates and telemetry metrics.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never produce flat, generic gray dashboard cards. Use precision HUD aesthetics with dark obsidian background (#08090C), crisp 1px borders with cyan glow on active states, and tactical bracketed corners.
Canvas landmark drawing must be performant: draw joints as cyan circles, connecting bones as semi-transparent glowing lines, and wrist joint in emerald.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive and informative nodes for reliable automated testing.
Provide responsive two-column grid on desktop (video HUD 7 cols, slide presenter 5 cols) and clean stacked view on mobile screens.
Include simulated demo hand gestures mode so testers or users without immediate webcam access or proper lighting can verify all gesture slide transitions smoothly.
